summary: RedHill Biopharma Ltd. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to increase the maximum aggregate offering amount of ADSs under its existing At The Market Offering Agreement with H.C. Wainwright. The filing updates the amount available for sale to $1,587,708, subject to Form F-3 General Instruction I.B.5 limitations based on public float. No special-situation event is present; this is a routine shelf takedown under an ATM facility. Ordinary capital-raising filings do not meet the definition of a special situation.
